title: RS-Claw-Evolution: Environment-Feedback-Driven Evolution for Lightweight Remote Sensing Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.22258v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model-driven remote sensing (RS) agents offer a promising approach to automating geospatial analysis. However, lightweight RS agents based on compact language models struggle with multi-step interactive tasks due to loss of long-horizon states, inefficient environmental feedback utilization, and sparse optimization signals. We propose RS-Claw-Evolution, an environment-feedback-driven framework that progressively improves lightweight agents through three stages. Interaction evolution uses executable code to control observations, maintain intermediate states, and reduce context redundancy. Experience evolution combines failure-aware trajectory generation with error-turn masking to learn from informative failure-recovery experiences without imitating faulty actions. translated_title: RS-Claw-Evolution：面向长时程任务中轻量级遥感智能体的环境反馈驱动演化框架
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的遥感（RS）智能体为自动化地理空间分析提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，基于紧凑语言模型的轻量级遥感智能体在多步交互任务中表现不佳，原因在于长时程状态丢失、环境反馈利用效率低下以及优化信号稀疏。我们提出RS-Claw-Evolution，这是一个环境反馈驱动的框架，通过三个阶段逐步改进轻量级智能体。交互演化使用可执行代码来控制观测、维护中间状态并减少上下文冗余。经验演化将失败感知的轨迹生成与错误轮次掩蔽相结合，从有信息量的失败恢复经验中学习，而不模仿错误动作。决策演化使用强化学习，结合多维环境奖励和轮次级优势保护机制，来优化工具使用行为并改进智能体的决策能力。
tldr: 提出RS-Claw-Evolution框架，通过交互演化、经验演化和决策演化三个阶段，利用环境反馈驱动轻量级遥感智能体在长时程多步任务中实现渐进式能力提升。
en_tdlr: Proposes RS-Claw-Evolution, an environment-feedback-driven framework that progressively improves lightweight remote sensing agents in long-horizon tasks through three stages: interaction evolution, experience evolution, and decision evolution.
